companyDescription: Rare metabolic disease · ersodetug (RZ358), an allosteric insulin-receptor antibody for hyperinsulinism — pivotal upLIFT readout in tumor HI due mid-December, congenital-HI path being reworked with FDA after sunRIZE
priceNote: Live $4.01 (flat) on Nov 4, 2026, -5% over the past week. The 52-week range is $1.07-$11.46: the low came after the Dec 2025 sunRIZE miss, and the stock has since recovered to ~35% of its high. Market cap ~$460M. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: The mid-December topline from upLIFT is the binary. upLIFT is a single-arm Phase 3 of ersodetug in tumor hyperinsulinism (~16 patients, fully enrolled Oct 14, 2026). In the interim look, 7 of the first 8 participants met the primary endpoint and came off IV glucose. After sunRIZE missed in Dec 2025 (~-87%), the FDA still recommended a Type B pre-BLA meeting on the congenital-HI data, and analysts have reset targets higher: Citizens $15, H.C. Wainwright $10, Craig-Hallum $7. Cash of $108M is guided to last into Q1 2028, so there is no survival flag. phase3_readout has n=1 in the feedback file, so it is context only. Base +80% is a 1-2 month post-data re-rating toward the $7-10 target cluster. That is well above the lane's realized 30-day P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp), so treat it as a post-readout horizon, not a 30-day call. แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า upLIFT พลาด ลงได้ 50-70%.

catalysts.name: upLIFT Phase 3 topline — ersodetug in tumor HI
catalysts.description: Single-arm pivotal study (~16 participants, 9 mg/kg weekly × 8 weeks), fully enrolled Oct 14, 2026. 7 of the first 8 participants met the primary endpoint at interim. Company guides topline to mid-December 2026.

catalysts.name: Congenital HI — FDA Type B pre-BLA meeting
catalysts.description: After sunRIZE missed its primary endpoint, FDA recommended a Type B pre-BLA meeting on the congenital-HI dataset. The meeting outcome sets whether a second, larger indication is still filable.

risks: Tiny, single-arm pivotal: ~16 patients with no control arm. One or two non-responders change the headline rate, and the 7/8 interim may not hold in the full cohort.
Credibility discount: sunRIZE (congenital HI) missed its primary endpoint in Dec 2025 and the stock lost ~87%. The market will haircut any 'positive' readout that needs caveats.
Even a successful upLIFT does not guarantee approval. The company says so itself, and FDA has not yet agreed a filing path for tumor HI on single-arm data.
Tumor HI (mostly insulinoma/NICTH) is an ultra-rare market. Peak sales are modest unless the congenital-HI label is rescued.
Expect a raise into strength after positive data even with $108M cash. The equity overhang caps the first-day move.

estimateDates.note: Primary endpoint: responders who discontinue IV glucose; interim 7/8
Cash/runway check; any FDA Type B timing update

macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset rare-disease biotech. The upLIFT readout dominates. Rates matter only through small-cap biotech risk appetite (XBI/IWM) and the price of a post-data raise.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · Moonshot 2.5% max — the most asymmetric dated binary on this screen: interim 7/8 responders, funded into 2028, and the stock at a third of its high. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 ($3.40-3.70) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Small-cap biotechs with a dated pivotal readout often drift higher into the event, but RZLT has slipped ~5% in the past week with the small-cap tape. There is no visible pre-run yet.

postWin.note: MDGL rose ~268% in one session on a clean Phase 3 (MAESTRO-NASH, Dec 2022). CAPR ran +300% in two days on HOPE-3 (Dec 2025). Those are top-decile outcomes on large indications; for an ultra-rare, single-arm study a +40-100% re-rating toward the $7-10 target cluster is the realistic base.

postLose.note: RZLT's own sunRIZE miss (Dec 2025) took the stock down ~87%. CMPS fell 36-47% on a Phase 3 that technically hit its endpoint but disappointed on effect size (Jun 2025).

spotSizing.reason: 2.5%. phase3_readout has no n≥5 bucket (n=1, context only), so the lane-wide prior governs: turbo hitRate 4.9% (2/41) and medianExcessVsBench only +2.0pp, which caps any turbo pick at 2-3% in a SELECTIVE/low-conviction tape.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the overall turbo medianMAE (-24.1%). A break below ~$3.00 before mid-December means the market is pricing a weak readout.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If upLIFT misses or the responder rate collapses, exit day 1. sunRIZE was ~-87% in Dec 2025, so there is no 'wait for a bounce'.
